description: Corrected registry-completeness audit with a not-applicable state, plus a side-by-side comparison of the phase 1 and phase 2 metabolic stability protocols to settle whether they are one system or two
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

FIELDS = ["protocol section", "biological material\nand source", "format",
          "exposure conditions", "replication (n)", "validation readout\non the system",
          "paper-stated\nlimitation"]
# 1 = stated, 0 = absent, -1 = not applicable (assay uses no biological material)
rows = {
 "1 Molecular docking":          [ 0,  1,  1,  1,  0,  1,  1],
 "2 Radioligand binding (PDSP)": [ 0,  1,  1,  1,  0,  0,  1],
 "3 PAMPA permeability":         [ 1, -1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1],
 "4 Shake-flask solubility":     [ 1, -1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  0],
 "5 HEK293T cytotoxicity":       [ 1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1],
 "6 Metabolic stability":        [ 1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1],
 "7 Guinea pig tracheal ring":   [ 1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1],
 "8 Rotarod":                    [ 1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1],
 "9 A/J plethysmography":        [ 1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  0,  1],
}
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, index=FIELDS).T
applicable = (df != -1)
df["completeness"] = (df == 1).sum(axis=1) / applicable.sum(axis=1)
print(df.to_string())
print("\nsystems with a protocol section: %d of 9" % int((df["protocol section"] == 1).sum()))
print("mean completeness systems 1-2: %.2f ; systems 3-9: %.2f"
      % (df["completeness"].iloc[:2].mean(), df["completeness"].iloc[2:].mean()))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5, 4.4))
m = df[FIELDS].values.astype(float)
col = {1: "#2b6a4d", 0: "#b03a2e", -1: "#d9d9d9"}
for i in range(m.shape[0]):
    for j in range(m.shape[1]):
        v = m[i, j]
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j - .5, i - .5), 1, 1, color=col[v]))
        ax.text(j, i, {1: "stated", 0: "absent", -1: "n/a"}[v], ha="center", va="center",
                fontsize=7, color="white" if v != -1 else "black")
ax.set_xlim(-.5, m.shape[1] - .5); ax.set_ylim(m.shape[0] - .5, -.5)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(FIELDS))); ax.set_xticklabels(FIELDS, fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels(df.index, fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("Registry-record completeness, PMID 37418196\n"
             "systems 1 and 2 carry no protocol section in the paper", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

# ---- phase 1 vs phase 2: one system or two? ----
cmp = pd.DataFrame({
 "phase 1 (method 4.7)": ["human or mouse liver MICROSOMES", "NADPH regenerating system", "none",
                          "10 uM", "0.5 mg/mL", "120 min", "n=6 (2 assays x triplicate)",
                          "LC-MS/MS depletion", "HZ166"],
 "phase 2 (method 4.8)": ["human or mouse liver S9, or mouse kidney S9", "NADPH regenerating system",
                          "alamethicin 0.0225 mg/mL", "10 uM", "0.5 mg/mL", "120 min",
                          "n=6 (2 assays x triplicate)", "LC-MS/MS depletion", "compound 1"],
}, index=["protein preparation", "cofactor system", "permeabiliser", "substrate conc.",
          "protein conc.", "incubation", "replication", "readout", "reference compound"])
cmp["identical?"] = ["no", "yes", "no", "yes", "yes", "yes", "yes", "yes", "no"]
print("\n" + cmp.to_string())
same = (cmp["identical?"] == "yes").sum()
print("\n%d of %d protocol dimensions identical -> variants of one method, not two systems"
      % (same, len(cmp)))
